default: Why we rebuilt — and what stays the same.

name: body_text
label: Body
default:
There's a reason we rebuilt Hair Solutions Co. instead of simply refreshing the logo.

After speaking with customers — including many of you — one thing became clear: the industry often makes this feel more complicated than it needs to be. We wanted the experience to feel more honest, more educational, more human.

You're part of the reason this rebuild happened the way it did. Thank you for being with us before all of this — it means more than a form letter can say.
